Sec. 6.3 gives a pooled phonetic (consonant) inventory and 6.5.5 a Jimbin-vs-Turdu [h] variation note; Appendix G (p.64) states: 'The transcriptions are preliminary since there was no in-depth analysis of tones or other phonological or phonetic features.' Its own literature list for Zibinju contains no grammar or phonology (Temple 1922, CAPRO 1995, Haruna 2005, Skinner 1977, Jungraithmayr & Ibriszimow 1994).
